# Take Care of Shadow Milk

> > A collection of free browser-based pet simulation games featuring characters from Cookie Run: Kingdom, built on Scratch with interactive gameplay mechanics.

Take Care of Shadow Milk is a fan-made game hub offering virtual pet care simulators for popular Cookie Run: Kingdom characters. Players can interact with and care for various cookies through drag-and-drop gameplay, puzzle challenges, and arcade mechanics in a casual, browser-based environment.

## Key Topics

- Shadow Milk Cookie
- Pure Vanilla Cookie
- Burning Spice Cookie
- Eternal Sugar Cookie

## Pet Simulation Games

- [Take Care of Shadow Milk](https://takecareofshadowmilk.com): Homepage for Shadow Milk Cookie pet simulation game from Cookie Run Kingdom
- [Take Care of Your Own Pure Vanilla](https://takecareofshadowmilk.com/take-care-of-your-own-pure-vanilla): Pure Vanilla Cookie pet simulation game from Cookie Run: Kingdom
- [Take Care of Your Own Burning Spice](https://takecareofshadowmilk.com/take-care-of-your-own-burning-spice): Burning Spice Cookie pet care simulator with interactive gameplay
- [Take Care of Your Own Eternal Sugar](https://takecareofshadowmilk.com/take-care-of-your-own-eternal-sugar): Eternal Sugar Cookie interactive pet simulator from Cookie Run: Kingdom
- [Take Care of Your Own Hollyberry](https://takecareofshadowmilk.com/take-care-of-your-own-hollyberry): Hollyberry Cookie care simulation with drag-and-drop gameplay
- [Take Care of Your Own Sage Of Truth](https://takecareofshadowmilk.com/take-care-of-your-own-sage-of-truth): Sage Of Truth Cookie mystical pet simulator with meditation elements
- [TAKE CARE OF YOUR OWN ETERNAL SUGAR! V1](https://takecareofshadowmilk.com/v1-take-care-of-your-own-eternal-sugar): Original v1 Eternal Sugar Cookie pet simulation game
